items.name: EDTLB
items.description: Transcription and story scripts, smart culling, beat markers, a render and ship queue, and Clank the AI copilot.

items.name: FLCKS
items.description: AI culling, raw editing with curves, HSL and masks, and a style page for posters and social layouts.

items.name: 3D Studio | G&G
items.description: A 3D studio in one effect: photo cards, extruded 3D text with Text Lab letter motion, logos, planes, shapes and OBJ / FBX models (vehicles that drive, balls that roll, Mixamo characters that dance), procedural clouds, a GG Models library, Scatter copies on a Studio, Grid Room, Arena, Woods, Flat Lay or HDRI set, with key, rim and object lights, reflections, a four-pose camera and a live viewport. Rendered by one GPU Fuse.

items.description: An After Effects-style timeline for DaVinci Resolve Fusion: layers, keyframes and curves, plus the GG Morph and GG Physics engines.

items.name: G&G Gobo Library
items.description: The gobo plates the 3D tools light their scenes with. 3D Studio, 3D Grid and 3D Flat Lay all need it.

items.name: Color Tools | G&G
items.description: The whole color line in one install: Grade with the G&G LUT library and client presets, Afterlight, Relight, Day to Night and Demist.

items.description: Transition Lab plus the Shift Lab transition and its presets: slides, burns, print, tech, punch, whip and focus transitions.

setup.name: DaVinci Resolve Studio
setup.tagline: Blackmagic Design · edit, color, Fusion and Fairlight
setup.description: The current Studio release, straight from Blackmagic. Runs Blackmagic's own installer, which asks for your admin password and shows the licence. Your Studio key or dongle carries over.

setup.name: Frame.io Drive
setup.tagline: Adobe · Frame.io projects as a drive on your Mac
setup.description: Mounts the team's Frame.io projects in Finder so camera cards, cuts and reviews are one folder away. Replaces Frame.io Transfer. Downloaded from Adobe's own update feed and checked against their checksum.

setup.name: Gyroflow
setup.description: The desktop app for stabilising footage from camera gyro data. Universal build from the Gyroflow project on GitHub, GPL-3.0.

setup.name: Gyroflow OFX
setup.description: Gyroflow inside Resolve: apply a stabilisation project to a clip in the Edit or Color page. The current plugin from the Gyroflow plugins project, signed by Gyroflow. Lands in the system OFX folder, one admin prompt. Restart Resolve after installing.
